title: Files of any size open on iPhone; reactions look the same everywhere
summary: On iPhone a big video or photo now shows in the chat like a small one, with its picture and, for a video, its length, and a file shown as a row opens with a tap. The desktop and iPhone show reactions as chips with the emoji and the count, as Android does, so a reaction set on a phone looks the same on the desktop.

changes.title: iPhone: big videos and photos show in the chat
changes.description: A video or photo over 20 MB came to an iPhone as a plain file row, and a tap on the row opened nothing. Now a video of any size shows its first frame and its length, a photo shows itself, and a tap opens them. A file that stays a row, such as a PDF, opens with a tap anywhere on the row once it has arrived. A big video you send shows the same way.

changes.title: Reactions look the same everywhere
changes.description: A reaction set on a phone, especially one from the full emoji keyboard, showed on the desktop as a small grey symbol under the message. The desktop and iPhone now show each reaction as a chip with the emoji and how many people chose it, as Android does. On iPhone your own reaction is highlighted.

changes.title: iPhone: a video keeps its length
changes.description: The length in the corner of a video disappeared when its message was drawn again, for example after a reaction or a new message. It stays now.
